title: RunInjection

answer.description: Whether runs receive credentials (the forge variables and credential helper, and the key managers' block): allow or deny.

id.description: The id of the routine (or bot, as the policy's actorKind says) whose own injection it is.

description: A run's own credential injection: its routine's or bot's allow or deny, which outranks its account's entry and the environment's value.
